domain(person,[shmoops]).

% If Shmoops senses energy or understands emotions, then it can build trust.
axiom(s1, rule([or(senses_energy(shmoops), understands_emotions(shmoops))], builds_trust(shmoops))).

% If Shmoops either respects boundaries or has empathy (but not both), then it values harmony.
axiom(s2, rule([xor(respects_boundaries(shmoops), has_empathy(shmoops))], values_harmony(shmoops))).

% Shmoops can understand emotions if Shmoops has compassion.
axiom(s3, rule([has_compassion(shmoops)], understands_emotions(shmoops))).

% Any being that prioritizes coexistence respects boundaries.
axiom(s4, rule([prioritizes_coexistence(X)], respects_boundaries(X))).

% If Shmoops either detects vibrations or senses energy (but not both), then it is intuitive.
axiom(s5, rule([xor(detects_vibrations(shmoops), senses_energy(shmoops))], intuitive(shmoops))).

% Shmoops does not detect vibrations.
axiom(s6, not(detects_vibrations(shmoops))).

% If Shmoops either reads body language or shares thoughts (but not both), then it is able to connect with others.
axiom(s7, rule([xor(reads_body_language(shmoops), shares_thoughts(shmoops))], able_to_connect_with_others(shmoops))).

% Shmoops is not intuitive.
axiom(s8, not(intuitive(shmoops))).

% If Shmoops has empathy, then it either builds trust or can read minds, but not both.
axiom(s9, rule([has_empathy(shmoops)], xor(builds_trust(shmoops), reads_minds(shmoops)))).

% Shmoops connects with others or understands emotions.
axiom(s10, or(connects_with_others(shmoops), understands_emotions(shmoops))).

% Shmoops can read minds.
axiom(s11, reads_minds(shmoops)).

% Shmoops does not value harmony.
axiom(s12, not(values_harmony(shmoops))).

% If Shmoops forms a telepathic bond, then it shares knowledge.
axiom(s13, rule([forms_telepathic_bond(shmoops)], shares_knowledge(shmoops))).

% Shmoops prioritizes coexistence.
axiom(s14, prioritizes_coexistence(shmoops)).

% If Shmoops connects with others, then it will form a telepathic bond.
axiom(s15, rule([connects_with_others(shmoops)], forms_telepathic_bond(shmoops))).
